title: Keep the Rehearsal Moving
author: Agile Lens
source: Original text created for the Understudy sample pack, October 28, 2026. Not a quotation or a device-readiness claim.

scenes.location: 60-second pitch at about 135 words per minute

entries.text: Original rehearsal text. Pause and resume at your own pace.
A performer should not have to choose between remembering a line and looking at another person. Understudy explores a simple way to keep the next words nearby.
A director arranges marks and dialogue. A phone drives the reading position. A connected glasses display shows a short prompt or a flowing script.
The point is not to replace rehearsal. It is to remove a small interruption so people can spend more time working on the scene.
We can test that directly. Load a short script, read it with a partner, pause in the middle, and find the next line again.
Then tell us where the display helped and where it pulled your attention away. That answer is more useful than a polished claim. We want a tool that earns its place in the room.
